lines: New India Foundation nurtures and celebrates excellence in Modern Indian research and writing by providing fellowships, and a book prize. The fellowship includes financial support, editorial guidance, publishing advice and community support.

Started in 2004, the core activity of the New India Foundation is the NIF Book Fellowships. The Book Fellowship is awarded to emerging and established writers working on topics that help create a more comprehensive picture of India post 1947.

The books published through the New India Fellowship span biographies to cultural histories to memoirs. While dealing in different geographies of India, the 35-plus books range from politics and law to environment and sports to gender and society to arts and culture. Each book is deeply reported, thoroughly edited and provides a vital perspective on modern India.
Since 2018, New India Foundation has awarded the annual Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF Book Prize for the best nonfiction book on modern/contemporary India published in the previous year.
January 2025 : Applications open to the public
The Girish Karnad Memorial NIF Lecture is a public lecture delivered by a leading intellectual on themes around modern India.
What is the Book Fellowship? What do you look for in applicants?

New India Foundation’s Book Fellowship allows fellows to write on different aspects of modern India. From hundreds of applications, the most compelling proposals are selected. NIF is looking for original topics, deep research, and relevance to modern India. The applicant could be a debut writer or a much-published author. NIF is simply looking for applicants who have a unique voice, an original idea and a deep commitment to the project which will result in the completion of a manuscript in the stipulated time.
What is the Translation Fellowship? What do you look for in applicants?

NIF’s Translation Fellowship seeks to bring historical Indian language works to English. NIF is looking for applicants who are adept in the source language and English, and who have prior experience in translation. NIF selects applicants based on the relevance of their proposal and their ability to translate the original text for a modern audience in the stipulated time. Like the Book Fellowship, the Translation fellowship is open to both published translators and debutants.
What is the NIF Book Prize and who can apply?

The NIF Book Prize is an annual prize given to the best nonfiction book of the year about India. The Prize is open to publishers who can nominate books, and to individuals who wish to nominate their own books.
What support do you offer beyond the grant?
While NIF provides a monthly grant to fellows, it also provides substantial editorial support, contact with publishers and agents, mentorship and community guidance.
